author: Skyzzeun
quote: This game is a complete disappointment. The graphics are underwhelming, the world feels empty and lifeless, the atmosphere lacks immersion, and the story is poorly written. Nothing feels truly impressive or innovative. After all the hype and years of waiting, I expected so much more from Rockstar. Unfortunately, this game fails to deliver on almost every level.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Skyzzeun
quote: This game is simply perfect. I honestly can’t find anything to criticize. The graphics are absolutely breathtaking, the world is incredibly detailed and full of life, the atmosphere is immersive, and the story is outstanding. Every single aspect of this game feels exceptional. Rockstar has truly created a masterpiece!
